table.agreement_rule: per horizon and for the four-horizon average, the three-seed mean of the replicated metric agrees with the published value when |mean - published| <= 2 x std_paper + 0.0005 (rounding half-unit); PARTIAL when <= 3 x std_paper + 0.0005; DISAGREEMENT otherwise. std_paper is the paper's std over its three runs of the four-horizon average (Table 7), applied per horizon as the only dispersion the paper reports; the replicated seed dispersion is reported beside it and never replaces the criterion
